scope: Prefix-only geometric/mechanical feasibility; no suffix evaluation, fitting or posterior training

normal_policy.normal: principal controller-centroid motion axis, signed by prefix net motion
normal_policy.plane_origin: current prescribed controller centroid + declared standoff * fixed normal
normal_policy.limitation: Straight approach direction is a proxy, not an observed tool surface normal

worlds: Three fixed plane offsets, shared median prior logits z=0; not random search
failure_policy: Preserve failures without fallback normals or modified solver gates
